info.title: Felslager API
info.description: API contract derived from the current Express implementation. Browser clients use credentials: include. All mutations except worker callbacks require an exact trusted Origin, including anonymous review submission and login/logout. Public filesystem reads allow anonymous access; captures, processing and review reads require a session. Production cookie names use the __Secure- prefix. Public signup and password recovery are not exposed. Paths in private APIs reject traversal, hidden components, backslashes and symlinks. OpenAPI cannot express slash-spanning filesystem paths or the HTTP MOVE method directly: path describes the wildcard and x-move records that operation. Express also handles HEAD for GET routes and global OPTIONS preflight (204 trusted Origin, 403 otherwise). Error codes depend on the endpoint; auth errors are supplied by Better Auth.

put.description: Stream a nonempty original of any content type. Default limits: 20 GiB per file, 100 GiB per capture (configurable), 10,000 files. Duplicate paths return 409. Interrupted uploads can be retried.

post.description: Queue reconstruction through Prefect. entryPath must be omitted; it is derived from the capture. Workers read capture files when preparing the run. Names are trimmed and truncated to 200 characters.

delete.description: Delete a terminal run, results and work files; preserve captures. Placement dependents prevent deleting their source.

post.description: Queue placement using a completed result with canRerunPlacement=true, reusing reconstruction and detections.
Queued cancellation is immediate (200). Active cancellation returns 202; poll until terminal. Already cancelled returns 200; completed/failed returns 409.

get.description: Immutable result manifest. Returns 409 RESULT_NOT_READY until completed.
Private worker callback; trusted Origin is not required. Returns absolute paths in shared private storage, including source paths for placement runs.

post.description: Private worker callback; trusted Origin is not required. Progress is rounded and never decreases. Operation metrics are accepted only during reconstructing.

Private worker callback; trusted Origin is not required. Imports files from the server-derived shared output directory; request body is unused. Requires model.glb and project.json with hits, cameras and Y_UP/Z_UP coordinateSystem.

Anonymous submission still requires trusted Origin. ZIP and expanded contents at most 500 MiB; review.json at most 10 MiB. Manifest requires version=1, draft.name (nonblank, at most 500 characters), assets array and actions array. Move actions require destination. No public files are modified.
